heading: Definition
lead: In this part, the term “executive agency” has the meaning given that term under section 133 of title 41.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: In text, “section 133 of title 41” substituted for “section 4(1) of the Office of Federal Procurement Policy Act (41 U.S.C. 403(1))” on authority of Pub. L. 111–350, § 6(c), Jan. 4, 2011, 124 Stat. 3854, which Act enacted Title 41, Public Contracts.
